failure_summary.description: Selected a restricted-range claim and accepted an unsupported counterexample clause instead of the established all-parameter bound.

patch.reasoning: The answer treated a bounded parameter range as evidence of failure outside that range. A concrete check for options that append an alleged counterexample can help prevent this, while preserving the existing exactness guidance.

edits.content: When an option gives a result on a restricted parameter range and then asserts a counterexample outside it, treat these as separate requirements: verify the result on the stated range and independently verify the existential counterexample. A theorem covering only the restricted range does not establish failure beyond it; compare the full option with any broader supported claim.
